sourceEvidence.meaning: Item Journal ist als stabilster direkt erreichbarer Mengen-/Lager-/Wertpfad beobachtet.
Item Journal kann in RM-DEMO Materialzugang, Artikelposten, Wertposten, Sachposten und Inventory Valuation als Labortrace liefern.

proved: Item Journal is a reusable material/quantity/location/value route in RM-DEMO based on existing Inventory evidence.
The route is useful for Inventory and for explaining the boundary between P2P document flow and inventory journal material effect.
No repeated posting was needed for this decision.
notProved: No creditor-side P2P receipt was created by P2P-013.
No Purchase Order partial receipt was fixed.
nextStep: For creditor P2P continue with Purchase Journal/Purchase Invoice value-entry gate; for Inventory continue with existing Item Journal trace as bookdraft material.
